old: This unit explains how light and matter both show wave and particle behaviour. Light behaves as a stream of photons in the photoelectric effect, and moving particles such as electrons have an associated de Broglie wavelength. NEET asks 1 to 2 questions almost every year from this unit, mostly on the photoelectric equation, stopping potential, intensity versus frequency graphs, photon momentum and de Broglie wavelength comparisons.
